based_on.change: Done-for-you service: set up and tune an AI receptionist for Open Dental practices, $500 setup + $299/month.

product.name: FrontDesk Fill
product.one_liner: We set up and tune an AI receptionist for Open Dental practices, so no new-patient call goes to voicemail.
product.customer: Independent US dental practices on Open Dental with 1-3 dentists and no full-time call handler
product.problem: Calls missed at lunch and after hours are lost new patients worth hundreds of dollars each

stack.choice: Retell AI voice agent + Open Dental API + a small Python service on Fly.io
stack.why: A service business needs setup speed, not a platform: Retell handles telephony and voice, Open Dental's API books the appointment, a 200-line Python service glues them.

alternatives.name: Build our own voice stack (Twilio + STT + TTS)
alternatives.why_not: Weeks of latency tuning before the first sale

alternatives.name: Resell an existing dental AI receptionist
alternatives.why_not: No margin and no control over the Open Dental integration
